spec_match.rationale: Implements the explainer's canonical 3P-comment-widget use case: legacy fixed iframe + postMessage scrollHeight script (600ms simulated latency) versus frame-sizing: content-height with the meta-opted-in child, and its copy states the spec's one-shot-at-load behaviour precisely, including the honest caveat that the 150→384px transition still happens once at load.

interactive.rationale: Live measured comparison — ResizeObserver settle timing, height-change counts, below-content displacement, buffered layout-shift PerformanceObserver entries — plus a replay control that re-runs both embeds and re-measures.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the comment-widget use case with measured layout shift and settle timing for old vs new; the page delivers exactly that table.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles unsupported browsers honestly (right column stays 150px with inner scrollbar and the summary says the legacy column wins), covers the late-postMessage arrival (summary recomputes on every settle after a fix caught in this cycle's verification), and documents min-height/aspect-ratio as the way to avoid even the one-shot shift.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5108373464547328, the explainer use-case section, and whatwg/html#555.

conformance.rationale: Covered by the feature-level suite (frame-sizing parses + grammar negative + requestResize contracts); this page's behavioural claims are measured live rather than asserted.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via CLI + CDP: autorun measurement observed the legacy column grow to 384px via the postMessage script while the frame-sizing column honestly stayed at 154px; the initial-summary staleness bug (finalized before the late height report) was found by this verification and fixed in place, then re-verified with a fresh DOM dump showing the corrected summary. Zero console errors; fonts.googleapis.com failures environmental. Note: --virtual-time-budget distorts the reported settle milliseconds in headless runs (13259ms for the simulated 600ms delay); real-clock browsers show ~600ms. The feature-enabled path was NOT observed (needs a 153 build).

telemetry_health.rationale: responsive-iframe-embed-widget asserts the supported path (384±px final height), responsive-iframe-embed-widget-unsupported-fallback separately asserts the honest fallback (new column fixed, legacy grew); telemetry fires once per measurement run and re-arms on replay.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only, table-layout fixed with overflow-wrap for narrow screens, buttons keep paired background/color, focus-visible outlines.

accessibility.rationale: Semantic comparison articles, data table with caption and th scope, metrics summary in an aria-live polite region, iframes titled, shift log labelled; widget avatars are aria-hidden decorations with author names in text.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-emulated: zero horizontal overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800; columns stack via auto-fit minmax(300px,1fr); mobile and desktop screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Characterize real layout-shift attribution with the feature enabled
openQuestions.detail: On a ResponsiveIframes-enabled 153 build, run the comparison and record: the frame-sizing column's settle time relative to child load, whether the engine's one-shot resize produces a layout-shift entry attributable to the responsive column (the page logs buffered layout-shift entries but Chromium 141 recorded none for either column in headless), and the final measured summary. Update the 'reading the numbers honestly' copy if the enabled behaviour differs from the described load-time settle.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive iframe embed sizing without layout shift
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Reserve space for media/embeds (aspect-ratio/min-height) to prevent layout shift; track overflow and layout stability; prefer intrinsic sizing over hardcoded dimensions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: the page measures below-content displacement and buffered layout-shift entries rather than asserting, and its honest-reading section recommends min-height/aspect-ratio reservation to avoid even the one-shot shift.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: metrics table + shift log in DOM dumps, 2026-07-26

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status updates for measurement readouts
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Dynamic results belong in polite live regions; data tables need caption and scoped headers.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: metrics summary is aria-live polite; the measurement table has a caption with measuring/settled state and th scope on both axes.

summary: The embed/widget use case demonstrates why the feature exists by racing the 2015-era postMessage resize script against frame-sizing on identical widget content, measuring settle time, height changes, below-content displacement, and layout-shift entries. Verification on Chromium 141 exercised the fallback branch fully and caught a real bug (summary finalized before the late script resize arrived) that was fixed and re-verified. The enabled-path measurement on a 153 build remains open.
